verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a first-party choice of storage location per project: Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync. With Git Sync, project data stays in your own repository and Insomnia does not host it, which lets users control residency by choosing where the repo lives. However, nothing in the pack documents selecting a geographic region for Insomnia Cloud data, so region-level residency is unproven. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection (e.g., EU/US data location), documented residency guarantees or compliance details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can convert a project to: - Local Vault - Cloud Sync - Git Sync
Your project data stays in your repository. Insomnia does not host or manage it.
Git Sync: for Git storage using any 3rd party Git repository, without going through the cloud.
